results.name: Multi-project preview draws background, sprite, palettes and canonical music from one donor
Canonical SHA-256 is independently verified and label/key order do not change identity
Sources are detached deeply frozen snapshots and caller edits cannot alter the pool
Base scene layout, collision, object references and full topology remain exact
Active root graphics mirrors follow changed target graphics only
Donated patterns/instruments are appended with every explicit instrument and order rebased
Preview audio uses the same canonical serialization order as Save and reopen
SFX definitions and runtime settings are preserved with explicit global timing warning
A seed and exact source pool reproduce the same full project and recipe
Random selection is independent of pool insertion order
Domain-separated randomness keeps other selections when one is pinned
Locked donor selections persist across new seeds
Keep selections retain every base asset and are reported as no change
Replay verifies exact identities and exact result SHA-256
Edited source content cannot substitute for a recipe source
Missing, extra, or duplicate recipe sources refuse without fallback
Tampered output identity and unknown recipe version refuse
Unsupported source schema refuses rather than normalizing legacy data
Missing stable identities and duplicate scene IDs refuse
Invalid CHR shape and out-of-range pixel values refuse instead of clamping
Invalid palette, nametable and collision references refuse
Unresolved animation and World references are rejected
Invalid instrument and pattern references cannot be silently clamped
Invalid envelope loops and unsupported pitch data refuse
Implicit first-note instrument donors are ineligible with an actionable reason
Unsupported tracker effects are kept as source data but cannot donate executable music
Different audio row counts are an explicit music donor incompatibility
Combined pattern/instrument capacity refuses atomically
Custom ASM in a donor is never copied or executed and custom ASM base refuses
Unknown options, nonboolean locks, unavailable choices and invalid seeds refuse
Pool size, source authenticity and per-source byte budget have bounded checks
Explicit nonactive target changes only that scene and preserves active editor mirrors
Scene/single-room preflight distinguishes structure from unproven full ROM capacity
A real named SFX keeps its IDs, pattern and instrument data after donor music is added
Unknown recipe fields and extra choice domains are rejected
Gameplay opt-in settings and lock replay remain deterministic alongside asset selections
Preview and every refused attempt leave live project and emulator byte-exact
